description: Mark an inbound transfer as drawing from seeded inventory, so it carries basis from the seed instead of opening a fresh lot at the transfer's price. A seed becomes a lot only once an inbound is designated against it.

smartAccountId.description: Account id the lot belongs to (from 'accounts list')

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: accounting_assertions_designate
